name: SendNapalStreamMessage

fields.help_en: The message ID. If not specified, the server automatically generates one
fields.help_zh: 消息 ID，未传则服务端自动生成
fields.name: message_id

fields.help_en: The text content. The natural language instruction entered by the user, such as a diagnostic request or question consultation
fields.help_zh: 文本内容。用户输入的自然语言指令，如诊断请求、问题咨询等
fields.name: text

fields.help_en: The raw content, used to pass non-text data
fields.help_zh: 原始内容，用于传递非文本数据
fields.name: raw

fields.help_en: The file URL, used to pass file-type content
fields.help_zh: 文件 URL，用于传递文件类内容
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The structured data, used to pass JSON-formatted structured content
fields.help_zh: 结构化数据，用于传递 JSON 格式的结构化内容
fields.name: data

fields.help_en: The list of message content parts. Multiple parts are supported
fields.help_zh: 消息内容分片列表，支持多个 Part
fields.name: parts

fields.help_en: The session context ID. Do not specify this parameter for the first conversation. The server creates a new session. For multi-turn conversations, pass the contextId from the previous response to maintain context continuity
fields.help_zh: 会话上下文 ID。首次对话不传，服务端会创建新会话；多轮对话需传入上一次响应中的 contextId 以保持上下文连续
fields.name: context_id

fields.help_en: The task ID. Pass the ID of the previous task in follow-up conversation scenarios
fields.help_zh: 任务 ID。续聊场景传入上一次任务的 ID
fields.name: task_id

fields.help_en: The list of referenced historical task IDs, used for context association
fields.help_zh: 引用的历史任务 ID 列表，用于上下文关联
fields.name: reference_task_ids

fields.help_en: The extended metadata, used to pass additional context information
fields.help_zh: 扩展元数据，用于传递额外上下文信息
fields.name: metadata

parameters.help_en: The message object that contains user input and session context information
parameters.help_zh: 消息体对象，包含用户输入内容及会话上下文信息
parameters.name: message

fields.help_en: The accepted output modes. Default value: ["text/event-stream"], which indicates that SSE streaming responses are accepted
fields.help_zh: 接受的输出模式。默认 ["text/event-stream"]，表示接受 SSE 流式响应
fields.name: accepted_output_modes

fields.help_en: The history message length. Controls the number of historical messages carried in multi-turn conversations. Default value: 20
fields.help_zh: 历史消息长度。控制多轮对话时携带的历史消息数量，默认 20
fields.name: history_length

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to return immediately. Valid values:

false (default): Returns responses in streaming mode.
true: Returns the task ID immediately and processes the request asynchronously
fields.help_zh: 是否立即返回。false（默认）表示流式返回，true 表示立即返回任务 ID 后异步处理
fields.name: return_immediately
